D/44 WPSS No.509 of 2025
With
Stay Application (IA) No.1 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. Sanjay Raturi, Advocate for respondent 
no.1 appeared through video conferencing. 
 Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, Additional Chief 
Standing Counsel for the State/respondent 
no.2.
 Heard.
 Admit.
 Mr. Sanjay Raturi, Advocate takes notice 
on behalf of respondent no.1.
 Learned Chief Standing Counsel takes 
notice on behalf of respondent no.2.
 Counter affidavit may be filed within four 
weeks.
 Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder affidavit, if 
any, may be filed.
 List thereafter for final hearing. 
 Heard on Stay Application (IA) No.1 of 
2025.
 By means of the stay application, the 
petitioner seeks directions that the 
respondent no.1 may be directed to permit 
the petitioner to work. The petitioner has been 
terminated long back after inquiry. This Court 
does not see any reason to pass any stay in 
the instant matter. Accordingly, stay 
application deserves to be rejected.
 Stay application is rejected. IA No.1 of 
2025, stands disposed of accordingly. 
 
 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 12.08.2025
Sanjay
